scenarios.name: Road blockage
scenarios.description: Two roads into Hospital Road are blocked. Watch the hospital lose access and the ambulances lose their primary destination.

scenarios.name: Power outage
scenarios.description: The Central Substation fails. Hospitals, towers, traffic signals and the control centre degrade in waves.

scenarios.name: Riverside flood
scenarios.description: A flood takes out the bridge, hospital road, St. Mary hospital and the central substation at once.

scenarios.name: Communication failure
scenarios.description: Central tower and radio repeater go down, so the control centre loses coordination of every field unit.
